notes.title: DEMO UPDATED FOR NEXT FEST
notes.content:
[h2]In anticipation of Steam Next Fest, the team has been busy improving upon the initial demo release.[/h2]

[h2]Sound Design[/h2]
All-new music tracks, captivating ambience, and improved sound design better capture the beauty of the mind and the emotions of the heart.

[h2]Camera Work[/h2]
Improved cameras provide a smoother and more satisfying experience. Whether playing in the massive open areas or a tight hallways, navigating the world is a breeze.

[h2]Run That Line Again[/h2]
Updated voice-acting and improved narrative elements deliver a more compelling & authentic experience.

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
A litany of other small changes and fixes improve quality across the board, and make playing the demo a second time highly recommended.
